title: Guided Meditation: support streaming ambient audio URLs

requirements.summary: Allow Guided Meditation ambient sound options to include and play full internet (https://) audio URLs while preserving existing local assets.
acceptanceCriteria: In Guided Meditation, ambient sound options can include full https:// URLs and are played successfully when selected.
Existing local ambient sound options (e.g., /assets/guided-meditation/*.mp3) continue to work without changes.
If a selected remote audio URL fails to load or play, the page shows a clear English error message and does not crash or get stuck in a playing state.

file_operations.description: Extend the ambientSounds list to include at least one option whose path is a full https:// URL, while keeping existing local /assets/guided-meditation/*.mp3 entries unchanged.

Update the ambient sound selector and audio initialization to accept sound values that may be full https:// URLs (not just local asset paths), and ensure audio load/play failures show a clear English error message, set playback state back to not playing, and avoid UI lockups.

requirements.summary: Use the selected ambient sound option value directly as the audio source and ensure switching sources while playing works without affecting the rest of the Guided Meditation experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing the selected ambient sound while audio is playing switches playback to the newly selected source (local or remote) without requiring a page refresh.
Starting/pausing/resetting the session continues to work as before and correctly controls the audio element.
No changes are made to the Enhanced Breathing page background audio behavior (it must still load from "/assets/breathing/ambient.mp3").

file_operations.description: Refactor Guided Meditation audio logic so the Select uses the sound's path (local or remote) as its value, and the audio element uses that selected value as its source directly; ensure changing selection during playback swaps sources cleanly (pause previous, set new source, load, and resume if playing), while keeping timer/breathing visual/script/navigation unchanged.
